# Lipstick Color Finder

> Lipstick Color Finder is a free website for finding lipsticks by how they actually look, not by shade name. It covers over 24,000 lipsticks from 520+ brands, from drugstore to luxury. Each lipstick's color is measured from its product photos, and matches are ranked by color alone. Nothing is sponsored, there are no accounts and no ads.

Use it to find a dupe of a specific lipstick, a cheaper alternative, a replacement for a discontinued shade, or a lipstick that matches a color seen in a photo.

## Tools

- [Dupe finder](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/dupe-finder/): search for a lipstick by brand and shade name and see the closest color matches from any brand, with filters for price, brand, format, finish and undertone. Includes alternatives to discontinued lipsticks.
- [Photo match](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/photo-match/): upload a photo, tap the lips, and see the lipsticks closest to that color. The photo is processed on the device and never uploaded.
- [Color wheel](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/color-wheel/): pick one of 46 lipstick colors on a wheel, then browse lighter, deeper, warmer or cooler shades and filter by price, finish and type.
- [Color chart](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/lipstick-color-chart/): pick any color on an interactive chart or enter a hex code to find matching lipsticks.

## Guides

- [Red lipstick guide](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/guides/red-lipstick/): how orange-reds, blue-reds and deep reds differ, where famous reds sit, and cheaper twins.
- [Pink lipstick guide](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/guides/pink-lipstick/): fourteen kinds of pink, where pink turns nude, and drugstore twins of well-known pinks.
- [All guides](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/guides/)

## How matching works

- [How lipstick color is measured](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/color-science/): colors are measured in CIELAB and compared with Delta E (CIEDE2000), which scores how different two colors look to the eye. Undertone and depth are explained there too.
- [How it was built](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/about/): product photos, computer vision and color science.
- [Privacy](https://lipstickcolorfinder.com/privacy/): what is collected and what stays on the device.
